title: Four-rotor rotary 2.6
description: Generated engine mesh for Four-rotor rotary 2.6 from its physical data.
frame: ISO 8855: x forward, y left, z up; metres; radians. The .glb itself uses glTF axes (+Y up, +Z forward, +X left): gltf(x,y,z) = iso(y,z,x).
origin: Crank axis at the flywheel face of the block; x toward the timing end, z up.
rest_pose: All node rotations are identity at rest; a node's origin is its joint pivot. Joint values are offsets from the rest pose (0 = as modelled).

sockets.name: socket_flywheel
sockets.note: flywheel face of the block on the crank axis (+x toward the timing end): the gearbox bolts on here

engine.source: class rule (the file is a torque map with no geometry): R26B four-rotor Wankel (the file's source): 13B-family rotor housings, generating radius 105 mm, eccentricity 15 mm, rotor width 80 mm [AS, recalled 13B values]
